grain_rationale: dataset.row_count is 13014 with duplicate_row_rate 0.0; airport_code carries 3 distinct values and observed_hour_utc carries 4341 distinct values, and 3*4341=13023 nearly equals row_count, showing one row per airport per observed hour. Because duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 there are no exact duplicate rows for the identity tuple to absorb, so the derived identity over (airport_code, observed_hour_utc) uniquely identifies each row and grain_type is transaction rather than aggregated.

fields.name: airport_code
fields.description: Three-letter station code with distinct_values EWR, JFK, LGA and null_rate 0.0, identifying which of the three airports the observation belongs to.

fields.name: observed_hour_utc
fields.description: Hourly UTC timestamp ranging from 2013-01-01T06:00:00 to 2013-07-01T03:00:00 with 4341 distinct values and null_rate 0.0, the event time each weather observation is timestamped by.

fields.name: observed_date_local
fields.description: Local calendar date ranging 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30 with 181 distinct values and null_rate 0.0, labeling the local day of each observation.

fields.name: observed_hour_local
fields.description: Local hour of day from 0 to 23 with 24 distinct values and null_rate 0.0, labeling the local hour rather than measuring a quantity.

fields.name: temp_f
fields.description: Air temperature in Fahrenheit ranging 10.94 to 93.92 across 130 distinct values with null_rate 0.0, a measured quantity comparable across rows.

fields.name: dewpoint_f
fields.description: Dewpoint temperature in Fahrenheit ranging -9.94 to 73.94 across 119 distinct values with null_rate 0.0, a measured quantity comparable across rows.

fields.name: humidity_pct
fields.description: Relative humidity percentage ranging 12.74 to 100.0 across 2178 distinct values with null_rate 0.0, a measured quantity comparable across rows.

fields.name: wind_dir_degrees
fields.description: Compass wind direction in degrees ranging 0 to 360 across 37 distinct values; null_rate 0.016828 makes it nullable, likely during calm-wind periods, and it labels a direction rather than a summable quantity.

fields.name: wind_speed_mph
fields.description: Wind speed in miles per hour ranging 0.0 to 1048.36058 across 36 distinct values; null_rate 0.000154 makes it nullable, a measured quantity comparable across rows.

fields.name: wind_gust_mph
fields.description: Wind gust speed in miles per hour ranging 16.11092 to 62.14212 across 35 distinct values; null_rate 0.745505 makes it nullable, consistent with gusts only being recorded when conditions exceed a gust threshold.

fields.name: precip_inches
fields.description: Precipitation in inches ranging 0.0 to 1.06 across 50 distinct values with null_rate 0.0, a measured quantity comparable across rows.

fields.name: pressure_mb
fields.description: Barometric pressure in millibars ranging 983.8 to 1038.4 across 430 distinct values; null_rate 0.114953 makes it nullable, likely due to sensor gaps.

fields.name: visibility_miles
fields.description: Visibility distance in miles ranging 0.0 to 10.0 across 20 distinct_values (0.0 through 10.0) with null_rate 0.0, a measured quantity comparable across rows.

fields.name: airport_name
fields.description: Full airport name with distinct_values John F. Kennedy International Airport, LaGuardia Airport, Newark Liberty International Airport and null_rate 0.0, labeling the airport.

fields.name: airport_municipality
fields.description: Municipality with distinct_values New York, Newark and null_rate 0.0, labeling the airport's location.

fields.name: airport_elevation_ft
fields.description: Airport elevation in feet with distinct_values 13, 18, 21 and null_rate 0.0, a static airport attribute rather than an observation measure.

fields.name: airport_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Longest runway length in feet with distinct_values 7002, 11000, 14511 and null_rate 0.0, a static airport attribute rather than an observation measure.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Ingestion capture timestamp with distinct_values spanning 2026-09-02T23:26:11 to 2026-09-02T23:26:13 and null_rate 0.0, recording when the row was captured rather than the business event time.

category_description: Each row is one hourly weather observation recorded at a specific airport, capturing temperature, dewpoint, humidity, wind, precipitation, pressure, and visibility conditions for that airport at that hour.
purpose: This mapping declares how the silver.silver_airport_weather table enters the gold unified event star as the airport_weather_observations fact category, naming the time column, grain, degenerate identifier, and field roles that the deterministic modeling engine uses to emit the gold fact and its dimensions.
usage: The mapping proposal is rendered into an ODCS mapping contract, validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, linted, and reviewed and edited by a human before approval; only then does the deterministic modeling engine consume the approved contract to generate gold models.
limitations: The mapping does not filter, impute, or reconcile the substantial null rates observed in wind_gust_mph (null_rate 0.745505), pressure_mb (null_rate 0.114953), wind_dir_degrees (null_rate 0.016828), or wind_speed_mph (null_rate 0.000154); handling of missing values is left to downstream consumers. It also does not reconcile the near-but-not-exact coverage of airport-hour combinations (3 airports times 4341 hours equals 13023 versus row_count 13014), leaving any investigation of the gap to consumers.
